query:
WITH bundles AS (SELECT sha256(bundle) AS digest, octet_length(bundle)::bigint AS bytes FROM workflow_runs),
 distinct_bundles AS (SELECT digest, max(bytes) AS bytes FROM bundles GROUP BY digest)
 SELECT json_build_object('runs',(SELECT count(*) FROM bundles),'distinct_bundles',(SELECT count(*) FROM distinct_bundles),
 'total_bytes',(SELECT coalesce(sum(bytes),0) FROM bundles),'distinct_bytes',(SELECT coalesce(sum(bytes),0) FROM distinct_bundles),
 'distinct_to_total_byte_ratio',(SELECT sum(bytes) FROM distinct_bundles)::numeric/nullif((SELECT sum(bytes) FROM bundles),0))
